# Nataka Inc

> Nataka Inc is a media, video production and marketing agency in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya. It makes brand films, TV and digital commercials, music videos, AI video (AI commercials, AI music videos, AI characters, AI effects on real footage), VFX and social content for brands, artists and agencies across Kenya and East Africa.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +254 725 107 294 · andrew@natakainc.com · https://www.natakainc.com/#contact

## Services
- [AI Video Production in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/ai-video-production-kenya): AI commercials, AI music videos, consistent AI characters, AI effects on real footage, live AI booths for events. Free 48-hour concept.
- [Video Production in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/video-production-nairobi): brand films, commercials, corporate video, events, social content.
- [Music Video Production in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/music-video-production-nairobi)
- [VFX & AI Video Editing](https://www.natakainc.com/services/vfx-ai-video-editing): compositing, motion graphics, colour grading, remote post-production.
- [Automotive Marketing in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/automotive-marketing-kenya)
- [Event Video Production in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/event-video-production-kenya)
- [Digital Marketing in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/digital-marketing-nairobi)
- [Brand Strategy in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/brand-strategy-kenya)
